summary: Known. C(n,k) = C(n−1,k+1) is equivalent to n(k+1) = (n−k)(n−k−1), i.e. to (5k+4)² − 5y² = −4, whose solutions are the odd-index Lucas numbers; those congruent to 4 mod 5 give k = (L_{4i+3} − 4)/5 = F_{2i}F_{2i+3} and n = F_{2i+2}F_{2i+3}, i ≥ 1 (i = 0 is k = 0). So every adjacent collision is in Lind's family, as Tovey proved. Elementary Pell-equation mathematics, not formalised; a formalisation needs the classification of x² − 5y² = −4.
